sentinel.name: The Sepulchral Sentinel
sentinel.lesson: Keep Aldric healthy. Prepare your next heal before another strike leaves him vulnerable.

keeper.name: The Cinder Keeper
keeper.lesson: The archer may hit anyone, including you. Switch targets while keeping Aldric ready for his next strike.

watcher.name: The Bone Watcher
watcher.lesson: Two archers spread wounds while Aldric keeps taking strikes. Recover the most vulnerable ally before the next volley.

warden.name: The Hollow Warden

mechanics.name: Crushing Blow
mechanics.hint: A heavy tank hit. Raise Aldric’s Health before it lands.

mechanics.name: Hollow Volley
mechanics.hint: Two marked allies take a volley while Aldric remains under pressure.

warden.lesson: Restore marked allies before the volley, then answer the heavy tank blow. Low Health leaves little room for a second hit.

briar.name: Briarbound Ancient

mechanics.name: Sporefall
mechanics.hint: Party-wide damage. Raise vulnerable allies before the hit, then recover the party while tank strikes continue.

briar.lesson: Recover the party after Sporefall while keeping Aldric ready for his next strike.

moth.name: The Mourning Moth

mechanics.name: Grave Dust
mechanics.hint: Party-wide damage. Raise vulnerable allies before the hit, then recover the party while tank strikes continue.

moth.lesson: Frequent pulses compete with tank recovery. Do not leave a wounded ally waiting for the next dust cloud.

boar.name: Gravetusk

mechanics.name: Gravetusk Stampede
mechanics.hint: Party-wide damage. Raise vulnerable allies before the hit, then recover the party while tank strikes continue.

boar.lesson: Prepare for the heavy tusk blow, then recover stampede wounds while the slinger threatens other allies.

choir.name: The Root Choir

mechanics.name: Root Lament
mechanics.hint: Party-wide damage. Raise vulnerable allies before the hit, then recover the party while tank strikes continue.

mechanics.name: Root Grasp
mechanics.hint: Hits 2 different living allies. Check the marked targets and heal the most vulnerable first.

choir.lesson: The sapling pressures Aldric during party recovery. The root grasp follows the lament; restore marked allies promptly.

mire.name: Mirelight Widow

mechanics.name: Mire Mist
mechanics.hint: Party-wide damage. Raise vulnerable allies before the hit, then recover the party while tank strikes continue.

mechanics.name: Widow’s Web
mechanics.hint: Hits 2 different living allies. Check the marked targets and heal the most vulnerable first.

mire.lesson: Mist, web wounds and wisp shots overlap. Stabilize the vulnerable frames while Aldric keeps taking hits.

matriarch.name: Elder of the Hollow Grove

mechanics.name: Hollow Bloom
mechanics.hint: Party-wide damage. Raise vulnerable allies before the hit, then recover the party while tank strikes continue.

mechanics.name: Thornfall
mechanics.hint: Hits 2 different living allies. Check the marked targets and heal the most vulnerable first.

matriarch.lesson: Bloom recovery competes with thornfall and sustained tank damage. Raise marked allies before another party pulse.

gatekeeper.name: The Cinder Gatekeeper

mechanics.name: Forked Cleave
mechanics.hint: Hits 2 different living allies. Check the marked targets and heal the most vulnerable first.

gatekeeper.lesson: Two marked allies take heavy cleaves while Aldric needs steady healing.

twins.name: Ashblade Captain

mechanics.name: Crosscut
mechanics.hint: Hits 2 different living allies. Check the marked targets and heal the most vulnerable first.

twins.lesson: Paired strikes and duelist cuts compete with tank recovery. Keep your next heal flexible.

ravens.name: The Cinderwing

mechanics.name: Searing Feathers
mechanics.hint: Hits 3 different living allies. Check the marked targets and heal the most vulnerable first.

ravens.lesson: Restore three volley targets before another round of tank strikes forces your attention away.

furnace.name: Furnace Colossus

mechanics.name: Twin Brands
mechanics.hint: Hits 2 different living allies. Check the marked targets and heal the most vulnerable first.

mechanics.name: Furnace Breath
mechanics.hint: Party-wide damage. Raise vulnerable allies before the hit, then recover the party while tank strikes continue.

furnace.lesson: Brands leave split wounds just before the breath. Raise vulnerable allies before committing to tank recovery.

harrier.name: The Ember Harrier

mechanics.name: Divided Pounce
mechanics.hint: Hits 2 different living allies. Check the marked targets and heal the most vulnerable first.

harrier.lesson: Fast tank strikes continue during paired pounces. Do not let either marked ally wait at low Health.

tribunal.name: The Ashen Tribunal

mechanics.name: Threefold Judgment
mechanics.hint: Hits 3 different living allies. Check the marked targets and heal the most vulnerable first.

tribunal.lesson: Three heavy wounds meet witness shots and tank strikes. Spend recovery windows preparing for the next judgment.

bridge.name: Ironwake Bulwark

mechanics.name: Shattered Iron
mechanics.hint: Hits 2 different living allies. Check the marked targets and heal the most vulnerable first.

mechanics.name: Ironfall
mechanics.hint: Party-wide damage. Raise vulnerable allies before the hit, then recover the party while tank strikes continue.

bridge.lesson: Shrapnel wounds must recover before ironfall while the retainer keeps pressure on Aldric.

bells.name: The Bellbound Shade

mechanics.name: Broken Echoes
mechanics.hint: Hits 3 different living allies. Check the marked targets and heal the most vulnerable first.

mechanics.name: Distant Toll
mechanics.hint: Party-wide damage. Raise vulnerable allies before the hit, then recover the party while tank strikes continue.

bells.lesson: Three split wounds meet a full-party toll four seconds later. Stabilize the vulnerable allies before the overlap.

regent.name: The Cinder Regent

mechanics.name: Sundering Decree
mechanics.hint: Hits 3 different living allies. Check the marked targets and heal the most vulnerable first.

mechanics.name: Crown of Embers
mechanics.hint: Party-wide damage. Raise vulnerable allies before the hit, then recover the party while tank strikes continue.

regent.lesson: Decrees, tank strikes and the crown overlap throughout this long fight. Recover marked allies ahead of the next crown.

huntsman.name: The Thorn Huntsman

mechanics.name: Barbed Arrow
mechanics.hint: One random living ally will bleed for 10s (68 every 2s). Heal through it; there is no dispel.

huntsman.lesson: This medium bleed outpaces one maintenance HoT. Commit follow-up healing while keeping Aldric stable.

hounds.name: The Sanguine Hound

mechanics.name: Rending Maul
mechanics.hint: Aldric will bleed for 8s (86 every 2s). Heal through it; there is no dispel.

hounds.lesson: A strong eight-second tank bleed needs direct healing as well as maintenance. Watch the whelp’s other victims.

roses.name: The Weeping Rose

mechanics.name: Rain of Thorns
mechanics.hint: 3 random living allies will bleed for 12s (28 every 2s). Heal through it; there is no dispel.

roses.lesson: Three simultaneous weak bleeds create a maintenance burden while Aldric continues taking strikes.

chapel.name: The Crimson Cantor

mechanics.name: Crimson Refrain
mechanics.hint: 2 random living allies will bleed for 10s (68 every 2s). Heal through it; there is no dispel.

mechanics.name: Grieving Hymn
mechanics.hint: Party-wide damage. Raise vulnerable allies before the hit, then recover the party while tank strikes continue.

chapel.lesson: Two medium bleeds are still ticking when the hymn lands. Raise both wounded allies before the party hit.

leech.name: The Vein Weaver

mechanics.name: Crimson Threads
mechanics.hint: One non-tank ally in sequence will bleed for 12s (68 every 2s). Heal through it; there is no dispel.

mechanics.name: Forked Fangs
mechanics.hint: Hits 2 different living allies. Check the marked targets and heal the most vulnerable first.

leech.lesson: Medium bleeds move through the non-tank frames sequentially. Follow the changing priority before fangs land.

procession.name: The Sorrow Bearer

mechanics.name: Endless Vigil
mechanics.hint: One non-tank ally in sequence will bleed for 12s (30 every 2s). Heal through it; there is no dispel.

procession.lesson: Weak bleeds arrive one at a time and build to three concurrent wounds. Maintain them while answering tank and acolyte attacks.

garden.name: The Briar Executioner

mechanics.name: Severing Thorns
mechanics.hint: One random living ally will bleed for 8s (86 every 2s). Heal through it; there is no dispel.

mechanics.name: Twin Shears
mechanics.hint: Hits 2 different living allies. Check the marked targets and heal the most vulnerable first.

garden.lesson: One strong bleed overlaps the shears. Stabilize its victim before the cuts; maintenance alone is insufficient.

cryptkeeper.name: The Bloodroot Keeper

mechanics.name: Bloodroot Bind
mechanics.hint: 3 random living allies will bleed for 12s (30 every 2s). Heal through it; there is no dispel.

mechanics.name: Falling Petals
mechanics.hint: Party-wide damage. Raise vulnerable allies before the hit, then recover the party while tank strikes continue.

cryptkeeper.lesson: Three simultaneous weak bleeds meet petals while the guard pressures Aldric. Set up recovery ahead of the overlap.

duchess.name: The Thornveiled Duchess

mechanics.name: The Bleeding Veil
mechanics.hint: 2 random living allies will bleed for 10s (68 every 2s). Heal through it; there is no dispel.

mechanics.name: Cruel Court
mechanics.hint: Hits 3 different living allies. Check the marked targets and heal the most vulnerable first.

mechanics.name: Scarlet Requiem
mechanics.hint: Party-wide damage. Raise vulnerable allies before the hit, then recover the party while tank strikes continue.

duchess.lesson: Two medium bleeds overlap the court’s split wounds. Prepare for requiem while keeping Aldric stable throughout the longest fight.

shaman.name: You
shaman.label: HEALER

spellBook.name: Recurring Surge
spellBook.description: Heal for 36 every 2s. Each cast adds 6s of remaining duration, up to 18s, without resetting the next tick. One effect per ally.

spellBook.name: Healing Wave
spellBook.description: Heal one living ally for 125 when the cast completes.

spellBook.name: Riptide
spellBook.description: Heal for 40 immediately, then 27 every 3s for 18s (202 total). Refreshing replaces the HoT and restarts its tick timer.

spellBook.name: Chain Heal
spellBook.description: Heal the selected ally for 105, then jump to the lowest-health-percentage unhit living ally, up to five targets. Each jump heals 20% less; all healing resolves at completion.

spellBook.name: Unleash Life
spellBook.description: Heal for 90 and store one empowerment: the next successful Surge, Wave, or Chain Heal heals 20% more and casts 20% faster. No expiration or stacking; Mana cost is unchanged.

spellBook.name: Healing Stream Totem
spellBook.description: Summon one Totem for 12s. Every 2s it heals the lowest-health-percentage injured living ally for 32 (six ticks). A tick is wasted if nobody is injured.
